title: Hamster Puzzle Keys
description: Complete the puzzles, move the candles to release the keys. The game Hamster - Puzzle Keys is waiting for you, compete with other players for the title of the best tracker! Puzzle about keys in the style of a Haster Combat! Feel like a detective! - Suitable for all ages. - Suitable for playing in any places and situations. - The game will appeal to boys and girls. - You can compete with other players in the game!
instructions: Move the candles with your finger or mouse to release the key
